[[File:Thrantax the Mighty chathead.png|left|70px]]
'''Thrantax the Mighty''' is a [[ghost]] that players must bring under their control during the [[Merlin's Crystal]] quest. If they fail, Thrantax will attack them.

During the quest, he can be summoned by using the "drop" option on [[bat bones]] while standing on the 12-point star in the centre of the gazebo, found in the garden northeast of [[Camelot]] castle.

He can be summoned an unlimited number of times as long as the player does not complete the conversation. The bat bones are not actually dropped—players can go back to the star and click the drop option again to summon unlimited copies of him, including multiple at once. He can be killed repeatedly for experience, and counts for [[Ghosts (Slayer assignment)]]. He cannot leave the gazebo and, if left alone for a while, will despawn.

==Trivia==
* While one player summons him to do the [[quest]] and is talking to him, another player can fight him and actually kill him.
* In ''[[RuneScape Classic]]'', Thrantax appears as a demon rather than a ghost.
* Although he is a ghost, the [[ghostspeak amulet]] is not needed to talk to him.
